name: 惰調
description: イラストレーター。 企業、個人問わずご依頼受付しております。DMかVColorColor@gmail.comまでご連絡下さい！ skeb：https://skeb.jp/@Datyou000

works.body:
Hello!

I would like to request artwork of my Vtuber! She is a Chinese jade dragon who lives is the world that has traditional and modern elements mixed together: https://arknights.fandom.com/wiki/Yan/Gallery
I would like a 16:9 image with the background and character in separate layers if possible!

Feel free to draw her however you like in whatever background you think fits!

Artwork will be shared or used on SNS with proper credits given!

Here is link the references of my Vtuber:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JHUjdqBsvOUsfiJDGpMgHxbP6079SboS?usp=sharing

Please pay close attention to my earring, the hair streaks and colors of my eyes ^~^

Hello! Your art is beautiful and pretty! I love the way you draw and color your characters

I'd like to request a commission of my VTuber! Can it be a horizontal drawing at a 16:9 ratio please?

Here is the link to the references for her: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WR_WuJz_Cag3l-ENZLRVgPZP-L14wkvs?usp=sharing
She is wearing dark blue eyeliner and no fang!

I'll leave the expression, pose, background, and prop usage to your expertise!

I plan on using art for Twitch, Twitter, Youtube SNS, etc., with proper credit given! If you could provide the PSD file with separate layers for the character and the background, that would be really nice.

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WR_WuJz_Cag3l-ENZLRVgPZP-L14wkvs?usp=sharing

Dear Kara, Nice to meet you! My name is Myro Soratou, and I am a personal Vtuber.

I fell in love with your illustration at first sight...! I would like to request you to draw me, Miro, as well.

Composition, pose, etc.: Please draw Miro singing a song.
I would appreciate it if the illustration is in psd data format, with the person, background, text, etc. in separate files.
I would appreciate it if the illustration is in psd data format with separate figures, backgrounds, text, etc.
We would like to see the original clothing, but we would be happy to see other clothing as well.
In the case of the original clothing, we would be happy to have some of it removed, such as armor or a cape.

We would like to have a three-sided drawing, profile (including some notes on clothing), and other reference materials.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Pc26lygzHagrv6xRq3SeERRicRxY_9Mb?usp=sharing
We would be happy to provide you with a video or channel that gives you a sense of the person in question:
https://youtu.be/PllrpZnociw
I intend to dress up as a man.

I would like to use your illustration as a thumbnail for a product or a video, etc. I would like to ask for your permission for commercial use.
If you do not, please cancel your request.

Thank you very much for your consideration...!

Nice to meet you!
I requested this because of your nice pattern.
If you don't mind, would it be possible to ask you to draw our OC "Shark Ice Shachi"?
For your reference, the setting is as follows, but you are free to draw it as you like.
I would be happy to draw it.
Shachi Shark Ice
She is slender and fair-skinned with long, straight black hair.
She wears a sailor uniform based on black and white and a sailor cap.
In addition to her idol-like energy and brightness, she has a neat and dainty appearance.
She is very curious and her hobbies are visiting theme parks and observing people.
She is a picky eater, and eats her favorite foods frequently. On the other hand, she also gets bored quickly.
Even when he is close to someone, he skillfully manipulates his emotions and uses them for his own convenience.
His words and actions are somewhat acting and exaggerated.
Inbornly lacking in empathy, what appears to be emotion at first glance is only what he has acquired as a result of observing people.
He is a very good listener and is very good at listening to others.
I would like to use the illustrations for my personal activities in general (e.g., illustrations for novels, introduction of characters on SNS and personal websites, announcements of personal activities, etc., sample materials for requests for commissions).
If this is convenient for you, please contact me.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jei9Iwcg2uY-ZixgeOuH2u12d-FL5dK4
